title: Relocate CLAUDE.md to .claude/guidelines.md for improved project structure
body:
**Bug Description**
 CLAUDE.md feels out of place in the project root alongside files like README.md: imoving it to the .claude folder (eg  .claude/guidelines.md)  would make it much less obtrusive.

**Environment Info**
- Platform: macos
- Terminal: intellij
- Version: 0.2.107
- Feedback ID: 4027623e-a50e-4cee-a6ed-780127fbd851

**Errors**
```json
[]
```

Related to https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/995
author: knoan
